brief: T6 PAVILION Architect Copilot, preserve BOTTOM-RIGHT character in Terrace variants source. Broad short limb-free floating head, warm ivory three-tier stepped roof with low broad pyramidal/canted slabs: wide bottom eave strongly overhangs face, middle smaller tier, smallest flat crown tier. ONE orange crown tab centered on front slope of top tier. Dark navy broad trapezoidal face tucked under deep roof; exactly TWO simple upright bright cyan capsule eyes, no mouth. Goggles-free: no goggles, glasses, lenses or extra optical brow shapes. TWO stout diagonal ivory cheek pillars, visibly faceted and layered near lower corners, taper down to short ivory chin beam; ONE small orange chin tab centered. Deep-teal faceted rear casing gives head depth. On character LEFT side ONE thick dark-teal beveled schematic side module bears thin white blueprint-scroll icon with simple rectangular plan cells, with ONE slim vertical orange strip beside its front edge. Preserve the source icon's simple appearance; no readable text. Other side and rear unseen in source: simplest plain teal casing, no invented ports, vents, buttons, screws, mechanisms or duplicate badge. Broad short silhouette and sheltered face, around 1.3 width to 1 height before depth projection. Soft matte low-poly planes, chunky bevels, consistent ivory/teal/navy/cyan/orange. No neck, body, limbs, pedestal, split cyan roof channel, goggles, compass crown or added props. Roof is integral core shell, not a hat. Side module is the only distinct fitted accessory. Unknown back surfaces conceptually inferred, not measured.
